    Tape

    Desk SETS is a transparent research toy for watching evolutionary search work on a small equities watchlist. It never connects to a brokerage, holds no keys, and moves no money. The out-of-sample window is short, the leader is chosen using that same window, and buy & hold is shown for comparison on purpose. Inspired by the architecture of SETS MACHINE; not affiliated.

    Keys: Space run/pause · → step · 1–4 speed · Esc back to leader · URL: ?ticker=NVDA&seed=42&speed=4&warm=50&paused
